hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);const f=(j.tool_response&&j.tool_response.filePath)||(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||'';if(f)console.log(f)}catch(e){}})" | { read -r f; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/frontend/*) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" || echo "hook de formato: prettier no pudo con $f" >&2;; esac; }
